<cap:headline>River Gandak at Dumariaghat in Gopalganj district of Bihar continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 6:00 am today.</cap:headline>
<cap:description>River Gandak at Dumariaghat in Gopalganj district of Bihar continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 6:00 am today. At 6:00 am, it was flowing at a level of 61.38 m with steady trend which is 0.16 m above its Warning Level of 61.22 m and 0.84 m below its Danger Level of 62.22 m.</cap:description>
